Chris is a great credit to his family, his coach John Powell and Belgrave Harriers. Currently at Harvard University, he will be returning home in 2000 for most of the track & field season, but for his great efforts in 1999 he has become the first recipient of the Bill Merryman Trophy.

John Powell is not one to stay idle. Having retired as Team Manager of our most successful ever Junior T&F team he has taken on posts as Secretary to the AAA of England (T&F) and British and English Junior Indoor Team Manager.
Men. 1 Serpentine 225; 2 Hillingdon 201; 3 Belgrave 112; 4 Richmond & Twick. 104; 5 Hercules Wimb. 93; 6 Herne Hill 79; 7 Met Police 62. M40. 100m: 3 J.Powell 13.1. 400m: 4 H.Corbett 74.7.

Troubled by hamstring injuries in recent seasons, Chris put his worries behind him and produced the goods for himself and coach John Powell, by racing to the gold medal in the European U23 Championships in Bydgoszcz, Poland.
Men. 1 J Powell (Durham C) 32:30; 6 M Byansi 33:41; 30 M Kazimierski 37:40. Women. 1 L Andreucci (ITA) 36:51; 7 H Smethurst 1st-W40 40:25.
